subject.title: [V3.5] Cron de materialización de rating Rainforest a products.attributes

question: Should the Rainforest materializer target the current ecommerce resolver path `attributes.providersRatings.amazon`, or should it align the resolver with the newer `attributes.ratings.rainforest_es`/root rating model first?
rationale: The original issue and triage target `providersRatings`, but later merged provider work introduced `attributes.ratings` and moved source data from `productdataraw` to `provider_records`; choosing the permanent contract affects the implementation boundary.

options.title: Populate `providersRatings.amazon` now
options.body: Read Rainforest from `provider_records`, write only `attributes.providersRatings.amazon`, and leave a later unification for the newer rating model.

options.title: Unify on `attributes.ratings` first
options.body: Update the resolver to consume `attributes.ratings`/root rating, then materialize Rainforest as `rainforest_es`, which is cleaner but broader.

options.title: Pause until rating model is settled
options.body: Keep the issue assigned while maintainers decide whether Rainforest, Keepa, and social-books should share one canonical product rating contract.

recommendation.title: Populate `providersRatings.amazon` now
recommendation.body: Read Rainforest from `provider_records`, write only `attributes.providersRatings.amazon`, and leave a later unification for the newer rating model.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned and authored the most recent merged rating/provider storage changes.
